notes.title: Demo is Live!
notes.notes:
It is time to set sail and send our foes down to the bottom of the ocean. [b]Warship Survival[/b] is taking part in the [b]Wargames Fest[/b] and you'll have the opportunity to try out the demo!
We are looking for feedback on what you like / dont like and what you think we could add that would improve the gameplay experience.

The demo will allow you to play up to level 4. The ships offers different gameplay styles such as torpedos, depth charges and turrets that you can send on a firing spree.
The full version of the game features up to 8 different ships with unique gameplay styles.

We hope that you'll have a fun time in this endless naval battle and we'll see you out there!
